title: The Cold Static
author: Odile Iversen
blurb: Kestrel Reyes, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
